title: Blanche Tries to Calm DOJ Ranks in First Speech as Leader
title_cn: 布兰奇在作为领导人的第一次演讲中试图安抚司法部的情绪
summary: US Attorney General Todd Blanche struck a conciliatory tone in his first speech since being confirmed to lead the Justice Department following months of turbulence and controversy that has tested the independence of the nation’s premier law enforcement agency and its credibility with the courts.

title: Hegseth Pressed on Test Office ‘Purge,’ Blocked Weapons Data
title_cn: 赫格塞斯敦促测试办公室“清除”、封锁武器数据
summary: Democratic lawmakers are pushing Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to explain deep cuts to the Pentagon’s weapons testing office and to restore decades worth of unclassified weapons assessments that were recently removed from the unit’s publicly accessible website.

title: US Sanctions on Cuba: Could They Force Regime Change?
title_cn: 美国对古巴的制裁：能否迫使政权更迭？
summary: Ever since US Special Forces captured Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in January and launched an attack on Iran the following month, Washington has been warning that Cuba will be next. Under a US-imposed economic blockade, the island has received almost no fuel in 2026.

title: Democrats Query Trump Jr.-Backed Firm in Blueprint on Probes
title_cn: 民主党人在调查蓝图中质疑小特朗普支持的公司
summary: Ranking House Democrats on a Congressional committee overseeing the nation’s mining laws sent a letter this week to a Trump family-backed critical materials company citing corruption concerns related to government contracts.

title: Trump Pivots to Economic Squeeze of ‘Entrenched’ Iran Regime
title_cn: 特朗普转向对“根深蒂固”的伊朗政权进行经济挤压
summary:
The US military campaign against Iran has so far failed to force the regime to capitulate. The Trump administration is betting once again that suffocating economic pressure will do the job.
Harrison Mann, former US Army Major and Associate Director for Campaigns & Policy at Win Without War, discusses Iran strategic mishaps, munitions concerns, and the mental health among Navy sailors as they hit a record 250 days at sea. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hungary Casts Doubt on Nuclear Plant Expansion After Danube Woes
title_cn: 多瑙河灾难后匈牙利对核电站扩建表示怀疑
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar cast doubt on the Russian-led expansion of the country’s sole nuclear power plant after the record-low level of the Danube river almost led to a full shutdown of the existing reactors.
